cases.description: Microsoft's documented example: cumulative distribution at x=42 for mean 40, sd 1.5
cases.expected_note: Excel documents this example's result as 0.9087888. Independently verified against the normal CDF: z = (42-40)/1.5 = 1.33333, Phi(1.33333) = 0.90878878 -> 0.9087888 at 7 dp

cases.description: Same parameters with cumulative FALSE returns the probability density instead
cases.expected_note: Excel documents this example's result as 0.10934. Independently verified from the density formula exp(-(x-mean)^2/(2*sd^2))/(sd*sqrt(2*pi)) = 0.10934005 -> 0.10934 at 5 dp

cases.description: At the mean the cumulative normal is exactly one half
cases.expected_note: The normal distribution is symmetric about its mean, so the CDF at x = mean is 0.5 for any positive standard deviation

cases.description: A standard deviation of zero is outside the domain
cases.expected_note: Excel documents #NUM! when standard_dev is less than or equal to 0

cases.description: A non-numeric argument is a value error rather than a numeric-domain error
cases.expected_note: Excel documents #VALUE! when x, mean or standard_dev is non-numeric
